item.title: NASA moon rocket hit by new problem, putting March launch with astronauts in jeopardy
item.description: The space agency revealed the latest problem just one day after targeting March 6 for humanity's first flight to the moon in more than half a century.

item.title: Baseball Hall of Famer Bill Mazeroski, known for walk-off home run in 1960 World Series, dies at 89
item.description: Bill Mazeroski, the Hall of Fame second baseman who won eight Gold Glove awards and the hearts of Pittsburgh Pirates fans for his historic walk-off home run in Game 7 of the 1960 World Series, has died at the age of 89.

item.title: Man struck and killed by hit-and-run driver in east Harris County, sheriff says
item.description: Authorities are searching for a fleeing driver after a man was hit and killed in a crash in east Harris County, Sheriff Ed Gonzalez said.

item.title: 'Jersey Shore' star Snooki says she has cervical cancer
item.description: Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi said Friday that she has cervical cancer.

item.title: This Week in Texas: Gov. Abbott, Dan Crenshaw, Steve Toth
item.description: This Week in Texas we have a conversation with Governor Greg Abbott at the start of early voting.

item.title: Thieves steal multiple AC units from northwest Harris County church, executive pastor says
item.description: The First Metropolitan Church in northwest Harris County isn't just a place of worship--It's a place with a food pantry that provides for many in need.

item.title: Burglary suspect opens fire at deputies, forces himself in home with children, HCSO says
item.description: The Harris County Sheriff's Office said a burglary suspect ended up inside a home, with children inside, after running from deputies and opening fire in north Harris County.

item.title: Winter has returned with chilly morning temperatures through Tuesday
item.description: Saturday's cold front will pave the way for a couple of cooler, wintry days for Southeast Texas.

item.title: Bodies of all 9 missing skiers in deadly California avalanche have been recovered, authorities say
item.description: Crews recovered the bodies of nine backcountry skiers who were killed in a California avalanche, authorities said Saturday.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry as a partial government shutdown continues.
